Bandpass.Description: Built-in amplifier band pass 0.15 to 200 Hz, 1-pole, so no sharp corner at 200 Hz; amplitude roll-off function in ns_1k_1_300_filt.mat (gestures README (SDR zk881ps0522)).

TaskDescription: Cue-based hand (fist close/open) and tongue movement. Series of cued motor tasks of varying complexity ('gestures'), meant to test interactions between primary motor cortex and other motor areas; cues were words on a bedside monitor; finger flexions of the hand contralateral to the grid were recorded with a 5DT dataglove (not included in this BIDS subset). Not yet published per the source README. (gestures README)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Subdural ECoG electrodes; grid location per source patient table kjm_ECoGLibrary_PatientTaskTable.pdf: R Frontotemporal
